moment.text: But a certain Samaritan, as he traveled, came where he was. When he saw him, he was moved with compassion,

previous.text: In the same way a Levite also, when he came to the place and saw him, passed by on the other side.

next.text: came to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. He set him on his own animal, brought him to an inn, and took care of him.

payload.place: Rocky, dusty Jerusalem–Jericho road in Judea, with stony hills and scattered thorn scrub, leading toward a roadside inn
payload.timeOfDay: Midday heat, shifting to late afternoon and evening at the inn
payload.weather: Clear, dry, hot sky with no rain
payload.light: Harsh, bright sunlight on the road, softening to warm golden evening light at the inn
payload.clothing: Travelers in plain tunics and cloaks suited to dusty desert roads; the Samaritan wears a practical traveling cloak and carries oil and wine

payload.primarySubject: The Samaritan in a practical traveling cloak, halting on the dusty road as he sees the wounded traveler, his face moved with compassion
payload.action: The Samaritan stops his mount and turns toward the wounded man lying by the roadside, bending slightly in quiet concern
payload.setting: Rocky, dusty Jerusalem–Jericho road in Judea with stony hills and scattered thorn scrub under a clear, hot sky
payload.secondaryElements: Samaritan's animal standing patiently behind him; a flask of oil and wine at his belt; wounded traveler half-lying in the dust; long shadows beginning to stretch across the road
payload.mood: Reverent, compassionate, grounded, with quiet dignity and hope amid harshness
payload.timeOfDay: Midday heat easing toward late afternoon
payload.composition: Medium-wide view along the road; Samaritan and wounded man in the foreground-center, the mount beside them, stony hills receding toward the horizon
